title: HB2586 (2023 Regular): Relating to the reciprocity of concealed handgun licenses.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2023R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2586/Introduced; sha256 f10f475e56389fcbe10b7a0f5adec13eb5212b569aad2960937c64e7a8acfaad)

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.173): (d) A person who is authorized to carry a concealed handgun pursuant to a valid out-of-state license as defined in ORS 166.370.
SECTION 2 (ORS 166.260): (j) A person who is authorized to carry a concealed handgun pursuant to a valid out-of-state license as defined in ORS 166.370.
SECTION 4 (ORS 166.370): (h) A person who is authorized to carry a concealed handgun pursuant to a valid out-of-state license, except as provided in subsection (1)(b) of this section.
SECTION 4 (ORS 166.370): (b) “Out-of-state license” means a license or permit issued by another state, or a city or county of another state, to carry a concealed handgun.
SECTION 7 (ORS 166.380): (b) A person who is authorized to carry a concealed handgun pursuant to a valid out-of-state license as defined in ORS 166.370 may present the valid out-of-state license to the peace officer instead of providing the firearm to the peace officer for examination.
